name: DKAN Datastore Import Tweak
description: Lets you configure the CSV delimiter and quote character used by DKAN datastore imports.
project_description: DKAN Datastore Import Tweak finetunes how the DKAN open-data datastore parses CSV resources during import. Out of the box DKAN does not expose the CSV delimiter or quoting character used by its datastore importer; this module adds a small admin settings form (/admin/dkan/parser-settings) that persists those two values and an event subscriber that injects them into DKAN's parser configuration when an import runs. An optional submodule, dkan_datastore_mysql_import_tweak, extends the same delimiter setting to DKAN's high-throughput MySQL LOAD DATA importer by decorating its import factory. The project is small and has no runtime dependencies beyond DKAN's datastore modules.
